name: An Albuquerque courtyard
blurb: A modeled courtyard at Albuquerque's Nob Hill centroid, with shade trees, open dry ground, and a simulated bird-bath water point.

facts.text: USGS classifies Albuquerque and the lower-elevation area west of the Sandia-Manzanita ridge as cold semi-arid (BSk).

source.title: USGS Scientific Investigations Report 2020-5095, climate classification

facts.text: The public Nob Hill centroid at 35.08, -106.60 has a USGS EPQS point elevation of approximately 1,590 m.

source.title: USGS Elevation Point Query Service at the public Nob Hill centroid

facts.text: The Rio Grande bosque is a cottonwood-willow riparian forest along the river in central New Mexico.

source.title: Wikipedia: Rio Grande bosque
